section_summary.extract_value: This section details the experimental procedure for a single study, outlining how participants were tested in groups, provided informed consent, and completed a sociodemographic questionnaire. Assessments included humor production, intelligence (fluid and crystallized, with balanced order), divergent thinking, and a creative achievements questionnaire. The entire session lasted approximately 90 minutes and received local ethics committee approval.
